name: copilot
description: Run GitHub Copilot CLI from Codex: verified read-only reviews, security reviews, rubber-duck critiques, and resumable prompts.

interface.shortDescription: Ask GitHub Copilot CLI for reviews, critiques, and prompts
interface.longDescription: Runs GitHub Copilot CLI as a subprocess in the current project. Use $copilot:review, $copilot:security-review, and $copilot:rubber-duck for independent read-only feedback, or $copilot:prompt for a write-enabled Copilot session that continues across prompts in the same Codex thread.
defaultPrompt: $copilot:security-review Check the auth changes on this branch
